The Waves are led by head coach [[Lorenzo Romar]], in the third season of his second stint after coaching the Waves from 1996 to 1999. They played their home games at the [[Firestone Fieldhouse]] in [[Malibu, California]] as members of the [[West Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 15–12, 7–6 to finish in 4th place. They defeated [[2020–21 Santa Clara Broncos men's basketball team|Santa Clara]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2021 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]] before losing in the semifinals to [[2020–21 BYU Cougars men's basketball team|BYU]]. They received an invitation to the [[2021 College Basketball Invitational|CBI]] where they defeated [[2020–21 Longwood Lancers men's basketball team|Longwood]], [[2020–21 Bellarmine Knights men's basketball team|Bellarmine]], and [[2020–21 Coastal Carolina Chanticleers men's basketball team|Coastal Carolina]] to become CBI Champions. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Pepperdine Waves men's basketball team|Waves]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 16–16, 8–8 in WCC play to finish in sixth place. They defeated [[2019–20 Santa Clara Broncos men's basketball team|Santa Clara]] in the second round of the [[2020 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]] before losing in
